# Duration

## Summary
Base-realm elapsed-time field decomposed into calendar units. Lives at
`https://cardstack.com/base/time/duration` (default export `DurationField`).

## API
- `years`, `months`, `days`, `hours`, `minutes`, `seconds` — NumberFields

## Usage
```ts
import DurationField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/time/duration';

@field contractLength = contains(DurationField);
```
Consumed in the shared realm by the App 2 Vendor card
(`contractStart`/`contractLength`). Units are stored as entered — the field
does not normalize (90 minutes stays 90 minutes).
